title: Add deterministic local scoring fixture for prediction MVP
description: Seed a public-safe call-center scorecard/score/version/item fixture with deterministic score config so CLI prediction can execute end-to-end against the local GraphQL backend without external model dependencies.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implemented deterministic public-safe prediction fixture in services/private-graphql-proxy/scripts/seed_local_demo.py: nira-demo-scorecard, nira-demo-score, nira-demo-score-version (champion), nira-demo-item-1, and matching External ID identifier. ScoreVersion config now includes executable class: TactusScore YAML/Lua logic for deterministic Yes/No output. Verified seed path by running docker compose local mode + seed script and asserting fixture/champion fields via GraphQL.
